payload.explanation: pg_stat_activity shows the business request (session_c44f192df25f, pid 465) active and waiting on Lock/transactionid, blocked by pid 464 (session_c1b6d6d6311f), which is 'idle in transaction' after running the same UPDATE inventory SET stock=stock-1 WHERE product_id=1 and now waiting on ClientRead. That idle-in-transaction session holds the row/transaction lock on product_id=1, so the business decrement cannot proceed. No evidence of large data, index issues, or vacuum problems (single PK index, tiny table). Uncertainty: none material; blocking chain is directly observed. Resolution path: roll back the eligible project-owned blocker session_c1b6d6d6311f to release the lock, preserving the business request.
